findings.excerpt: Stuart Neumann opened TEG 16 with 39 points at Oitavos Dunes.
He picked up 9 points across the first three holes, a bogey-par-bogey start that still returned three points a hole.
By the close Neumann led the TEG 16 Trophy outright.
Gregg Williams topped the Green Jacket standings instead, which is ordinary handicapping rather than mystery.

findings.excerpt: This was Neumann's third visit to Oitavos Dunes.
His gross score was two strokes better than his previous trip here, and still short of his personal best at the course.
Alex Baker opened this year's TEG at Oitavos Dunes with a gross 113.

findings.detail: claim type 'record' has no checker yet
findings.excerpt: It is the worst round anyone has posted at the course across three TEG visits.

findings.detail: claim type 'record' has no checker yet
findings.excerpt: The previous worst, 111, had stood across twelve prior rounds.
It was also, comfortably, his own worst outing here: ten shots worse than his last visit, and thirty adrift of his own course-best 103.
He added another quintuple at the 11th, and a quadruple at the 7th.
Holes 16 through 18 cost him eleven shots, produced no net par at all, and yielded two Stableford points between them.
A separate three-hole bleed from the 3rd to the 5th, on a run taking in the course's hardest hole, added a further seven gross shots.

findings.excerpt: Jon Baker assembled a new personal best at Oitavos Dunes on the opening day of the 2023 TEG Trophy, his third visit to the course.
His gross 92 beat the 94 he had set across two earlier visits.
That is two shots better than his mark from his last time out here.
Then came the 17th. A double bogey, on one of the harder holes out there, ended the sequence and took back ground he had only just gained.
Gregg Williams carded 89 at Oitavos Dunes on day one.
It beat the 91 he had managed across his two previous visits, a new course best, and it put him top of the TEG 16 Green Jacket.
